hero.title: Branded Link Cloaking, Automated Legal Compliance, and Zero Database Bloat
hero.subtitle: Transform complicated affiliate URLs into high-converting branded links while automating FTC disclosures, dynamic geolocation, and conversion split testing.

bottlenecks.title: Core Operational Bottlenecks Solved
bottlenecks.subtitle: Eliminate commission loss, compliance risks, and database degradation with a modern link management architecture.

items.title: Commission Theft & Link Hijacking
items.desc: Unbranded URLs reveal raw affiliate IDs that browser extensions hijack; our custom slugs protect your brand and commission earnings.

items.title: Regulatory Fines & Inconvenience
items.desc: FTC guidelines mandate conspicuous disclosures on referral links; our engine automatically detects links and programmatically injects accessible notices.

items.title: Database Slowdowns
items.desc: Traditional plugins generate millions of custom database rows that degrade server queries; we run on native WordPress Custom Post Types with sub-millisecond template routing.

features.title: Comprehensive Feature Breakdown
features.subtitle: Modular, high-performance link cloaking engineered for serious WordPress publishers.

coreEngine.title: Custom Cloaked Slug Architecture
coreEngine.desc: Convert long referral URLs into clean links using custom prefixes such as /go/, /recommends/, or /deal/.

coreEngine.title: High-Speed HTTP Status Handling
coreEngine.desc: Full support for native 301 permanent, 302 temporary, and 307 dynamic redirections with cache-control headers.

coreEngine.title: Automatic SEO Attribute Enforcement
coreEngine.desc: Automatically append rel="nofollow sponsored" and rel="noopener noreferrer" across all cloaked links.

coreEngine.title: Administrative Dashboard
coreEngine.desc: Clean link manager with instant search, merchant category grouping, and one-click copy-to-clipboard actions.

legalCompliance.title: Dynamic FTC Auto-Disclosure Injector
legalCompliance.desc: Automatically identifies cloaked URLs inside content and inserts compliant legal disclosures.

legalCompliance.title: Flexible Positioning
legalCompliance.desc: Insert disclosures at the top of content, at the bottom, or immediately preceding the first commercial link.

legalCompliance.title: Semantic & Accessible Markup
legalCompliance.desc: Built with accessible semantic HTML elements designed to blend smoothly with any WordPress theme.

proModules.title: Dynamic Geolocation Routing
proModules.desc: Automatically routes traffic to country-specific merchant storefronts based on real-time visitor IP geolocation.

proModules.title: A/B Split Testing & Traffic Rotation
proModules.desc: Distribute inbound clicks across multiple target URLs with percentage weights to identify top-converting vendor landing pages.

proModules.title: Dynamic UTM Forwarding
proModules.desc: Intercepts inbound UTM query parameters and automatically attaches them to the destination link.

proModules.title: Automated Deal Expiration & Fallbacks
proModules.desc: Establish calendar expiration dates or click thresholds that route visitors to evergreen fallback deals instead of dead 404 pages.

proModules.title: DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker
proModules.desc: Automatically transforms target keywords in existing posts into cloaked links without breaking headings, existing hyperlinks, or code blocks.

proModules.title: Automated 404 Link Health Scanner
proModules.desc: Background health checks that alert you when affiliate destination links go offline or change.
